Image fixtures are small procedural test images created with Pillow for this repository, not third-party artwork. transparent.png covers alpha; ordinary.jpg covers unmodified JPEG payloads; orientation6.jpg includes EXIF orientation 6 and asymmetric pixels.
pixel-budget.png is a uniformly filled 3000×3000 grayscale PNG used to check the aggregate pixel budget before a repeated occurrence is decoded.
project-review.docx was generated by this adapter from office-formats/tests/fixtures/project-review-images.writer (two sections, three procedural images, Unicode descriptions). libreoffice-review.docx was independently generated by LibreOfficeDev 26.8.0.0.alpha0 (2c87e51e), converting that fixture through its ODT representation. Both contain only repository-generated content.
